semiconductor_relevance: High — Poro Technologies Ltd specializes in advanced materials and technologies for microLEDs, which are integral to semiconductor applications in AR devices.
summary: Poro Technologies Ltd is focused on developing ultra-low-power, full-colour microLEDs on silicon, leveraging their proprietary PoroGaN® material platform. They operate an end-to-end design-manufacture-test loop that includes epitaxy and device design, catering to the needs of OEMs in the semiconductor space.
capabilities: DynamicPixelTuning® architecture for full colour gamut emission

regional_presence.United Kingdom: Poro Technologies Ltd is based in Cambridge, UK, and has partnerships across the region.
